Bengal sets up round-the-clock 'War Room' to track and counter misinformation

The West Bengal government has set up a round-the-clock 'War Room' to monitor and counter misinformation on social media platforms. The room is staffed by officials from the state's information department, who will track and respond to fake news and false information spread online. The move aims to strengthen grievance redressal and counter misinformation. The War Room will also provide a platform for citizens to report instances of fake news and misinformation. The government has issued social media guidelines to ensure that users are aware of the consequences of spreading false information.
